title: Unary witnesses are in nondeterministic polynomial time
statement: Let $B$ be a language of finite Boolean words. The language consisting of the words that are all true bits of some length $n$, for which there exists a word $x$ of length $n$ belonging to $B$, is in nondeterministic polynomial time with oracle $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a language of finite Boolean words
